newsitem.title: USA: Old Republic boosts payout to $0.13/shr.
newsitem.headline: Old Republic boosts payout to $0.13/shr.

text.p: Old Republic International Corp said its board of directors declared a cash dividend of $0.13 per share, up 18 percent from the previous level of $0.11 per share.
The dividend is payable June 16 to shareholders of record on June 6.

The company also said its board of directors extended Old Republic's shareholder rights plan originally adopted in June 1987. The plan, as amended, extends the expiration date of the original plan to June 26, 2007, and effects certain technical changes intended to update the existing plan.
The insurance holding company said the rights plan was not renewed due to any known threat.
